nodes.body: @ji-huazhong Seems some Ascend ci still use mbridge, please migrate to megatron-bridge.

The current SGLang Ascend CI image still uses Python 3.11 and Megatron-Core/MindSpeed 0.16, and lacks Megatron-Bridge and MindSpeed-Bridge. Supporting the new bridge stack requires upgrading these dependencies together; installing the two bridge packages alone is insufficient.
We have temporarily disabled the two Megatron + SGLang Ascend CI jobs. They should be re-enabled once the Ascend team updates the CI image with a compatible dependency stack and validates both test cases on A3 hardware. cc @wucong25
I think this not needed anymore, since they're explicitly specified under `megatron`.

issue_comments.body: @ji-huazhong Seems some Ascend ci still use mbridge, please migrate to megatron-bridge.

The current SGLang Ascend CI image still uses Python 3.11 and Megatron-Core/MindSpeed 0.16, and lacks Megatron-Bridge and MindSpeed-Bridge. Supporting the new bridge stack requires upgrading these dependencies together; installing the two bridge packages alone is insufficient.
We have temporarily disabled the two Megatron + SGLang Ascend CI jobs. They should be re-enabled once the Ascend team updates the CI image with a compatible dependency stack and validates both test cases on A3 hardware. cc @wucong25
